acceptances.reason: GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv and GHSA-7pqw-9j4j-h8q3 in extract-zip: symlink path traversal / arbitrary file writes when unpacking an archive. Reached only through the Lighthouse and size-limit toolchain, which uses it to unpack a Chrome build downloaded from Google over TLS during a performance run. No archive here is attacker-supplied, and none of these packages ship in the application bundle. Upstream has no patched release (extract-zip latest is 2.0.1, range <=2.0.1), and the only fix npm proposes is a semver-major change of @lhci/cli, which would take the performance gate below the version its evidence format depends on. Re-review when extract-zip publishes a fix or @puppeteer/browsers drops it.

GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 in zod <4.6.6: memory exhaustion when validating oversized constrained collections (denial of service only, no data exposure). @ag-ui/core and @ag-ui/client pin zod 3.25.76, a line that receives no patch; the application itself and every other consumer already run zod 4.6.7. The affected copy only validates AG-UI protocol events exchanged with our own agent endpoint, not arbitrary third-party input. Cannot be fixed without a major @ag-ui/client change that supports zod 4. Re-check when an @ag-ui/client release supports zod 4.
